Autorickshaw Injures Girl in Hyderabad; Driver Apprehended

An 11-year-old girl was injured after being struck by a speeding autorickshaw in Hyderabad's Hydershakote area. The incident, captured on camera, resulted in the girl sustaining a severe head injury. Police have apprehended the autorickshaw driver following the accident.
